heroText: Sillink Groupd is a multi-sector enterprise spanning ten industries — from telecommunications and energy to logistics, real estate and manufacturing — connected by a single link to progress.
aboutTitle: One group. Ten industries. A single link to progress.
aboutText: Sillink Groupd is a diversified conglomerate established to carry on business across telecommunications, energy, transport, real estate, media, contracting, manufacturing, equipment, financial services and ancillary activities — connecting the pillars of a modern economy under one trusted name.
footerText: Sillink Groupd is a diversified conglomerate linking ten industries — from telecommunications and energy to logistics, real estate and manufacturing — under one vision.
businesses: Telecommunications, ICT & Network
Telecommunications, communication services, ICT and network solutions — sale, supply, installation and maintenance of telecom equipment, cables and related technologies.
Energy, Power & Renewable Energy
Solar generation, renewable energy systems, and the design, installation and management of energy systems, power plants and distribution networks.
Transport, Logistics & Haulage
Transportation, logistics, haulage and carriage — ownership, operation, leasing and management of motor vehicles and transport equipment.
Real Estate & Property Services
Acquiring, developing, managing, leasing and selling land, buildings and real estate of every description, with property development and agency services.
Media, Publishing & Communication
Media operations, publishing, printing and distribution of newspapers, journals, magazines, newsletters and digital publications.
Contracting, Procurement & Supply
General contracting, procurement, importation, exportation, marketing, sales, distribution and supply of goods, equipment and merchandise.
Manufacturing & Industrial Services
Manufacturing, processing, packaging and distribution of goods and products of various descriptions, independently or in association with partners.
Equipment, Machinery & Asset Services
Buying, selling, leasing, hiring and distributing machinery, equipment, vehicles and commercial assets of every description.
Financial, Investment & Corporate
Raising, borrowing, investing and managing funds, with financial, investment and corporate activities supporting the Group’s objectives.
Ancillary & Related Services
All other lawful businesses, services and transactions incidental, complementary or conducive to the attainment of the Group’s objects.
why: Ten integrated business divisions under one group, spanning telecoms, energy, logistics, real estate and more.
From infrastructure and equipment to media and financial support — connected solutions across the value chain.
Built on procurement, contracting and corporate governance standards that earn institutional trust.
Renewable energy, ICT and industrial innovation driving sustainable, long-term growth.
